seven@sevenzx:~/ios-s9/s9$ cd ~/ios-s9/s9

CROSS=aarch64-linux-gnu-
for o in out/obj/*.o; do
    echo "===== $o ====="
    ${CROSS}readelf -r -W "$o" | grep -E \
      'ABS64|ABS32|ABS16|R_AARCH64' || true
done
